**Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The only MFN mechanic in this Agreement runs in our favour. Section 6 (p0047) requires TrueLink to hold Hosting Services rates at or below what it charges any other party, together with a one-year price freeze. I checked the compensation section (§§ 5–6), the licence/services provisions (§§ 2–4), and Client's covenants and warranties (§ 8), and ran targeted searches for parity, "no less favorable", best-price, right-to-match and preferred-provider language. Nothing obliges Mortgage Logic.com to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and there is no disclosure or right-to-match mechanic burdening us.

This satisfies the preferred position outright (no Customer MFN obligation benefiting Vendor), so the Vendor-granted MFN is preserved untouched.
